policies.shield: shield HP = scaled Minecraft health minus Guardian health pool (PvE 200=70+130, Crucible 230=100+130)
policies.scaling: activates at <=40 shield HP; effect=(80-shield)/80 linear; ends when shield >=80
policies.handling: fractional +30 handling evaluated on the original stat curve without rounding the stat

source.officialDescription: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.
source.ddcText: 93 Eye of the Storm As Shield HP drops, initially triggering at 40 Shield HP , maxing out in effect at 0 Shield HP : Linearly grants up to +30 ↑+33 Handling, -40% ↑-44% Accuracy Cone Size, and -17% ↑-19% Accuracy Cone Growth. Buff dynamically scales from 0% effect at 80 Shield HP , up to 100% effect at 0 Shield HP (also known as Critical Health ) Buff lasts until Shields are restored to 80 Shield HP .
source.scope: PvE base (non-enhanced); '?' values are not facts, see policies
